decisions.reason: As a niche coffee-based men's care line launched recently and with no later website evidence, it looks less central to a German chemical/cosmetics firm's core assortment and more likely to be discontinued if sales stayed modest.

As a cleansing foam added as 'Nachwuchs' to an existing Sandorini series, it appears to be a more natural line extension with better fit to the firm's skincare business, so it is more likely to be retained unless performance clearly disappoints.
